items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw FIRST image 初始攻击 preserving exact original LANDSCAPE 896:679 composition, front camera, sword proportions and placements. Preserve distinctive large curved steel guards near center below collision, mirrored guards forming original broad U-like outline. Images 2–4 are STYLE ONLY references for large opaque brush masses and confident simplified painting, do not copy characters, poses or clothes. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
